authoritative_freeze_timestamp: GitHub protected-main merge event for this amendment; dates before promotion describe candidate bytes, not acceptance.
supersedes: The EFR-R2 permitted specification package only. No endpoint, threshold, sample or stratum count, inclusion/exclusion rule, allocation, missing-data rule, analysis, or other registered test is amended.

defect.summary: The registered EFR-R2 acceptance criterion compares error category for every item, but the published specifications did not determine error category.
findings: far-ir/2.0 emits 26 diagnostic codes and far-ir/2.1 emits 41; the specifications named only W5_SEMANTICS_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Two far-ir/2.1 codes are composed at runtime as DUPLICATE_{label} and appear as no source literal.
Diagnostics are an ordered sequence with per-item multiplicity, which was unstated.

Both verifiers share one diagnostic sequence and abandon later checks when it is non-empty for any reason, so an unrelated cross-field defect suppresses the claim-specific check entirely. This was unstated.
defect.worked_example: A far-ir/2.0 record carrying both FREEZE_HASH_MISMATCH and a genuine decoder error yields exactly [FREEZE_HASH_MISMATCH]; an implementer following the prior prose would emit FACTORIZATION_FAILURE as well.
defect.consequence: EFR-R2 was unsatisfiable for specification reasons unrelated to far-ir semantics. Two correct clean-room implementations could not have converged.

mandatory_consequence.rule: EFR-R2 MUST NOT execute against the corrected specifications under the unamended v1.0 freeze.
mandatory_consequence.basis: EFR-001 v1.0 permits later intake to supply only identities, dates, sources and observations, and permits no later scientific design choices. Which specification bytes a clean-room team receives is a design choice.
mandatory_consequence.effect_if_violated: The test becomes retrospectively specified and forfeits confirmatory status.
